The content of the file was generated with Claude Opus 5.5 using Digdir's MCP server against Lovdata's API. 
The file contains statutory duties (and some voluntary tasks) broken down by education level and by who is responsible for the tasks. Every task is linked to the act or regulation where it is covered, and to the section where the task is described. The document contains tasks that belong to public bodies and educational institutions.
A manual check has been made of the municipality's tasks related to kindergartens. Some adjustments were needed here, and some tasks that were missing have been added, but there is nothing to suggest hallucinations, and nothing has had to be removed because it was not covered in the law. These changes are marked in the column "Reviewed manually". 
The assessment is therefore that the list may be somewhat inaccurate and that some details may be missing, but that what is in the list can also be found in the legal texts. For the purpose related to domain models, the quality of the list is considered good enough.
